title: Meeting Rooms
keyIdea: One person can attend every meeting only if no two overlap. After sorting by start, any clash must be with the meeting just before, so check start[i] < end[i − 1] for each neighbour.

approaches.name: Sort by start, check neighbours
approaches.idea: I wrote this one (you didn't paste code). Sort; return false if any meeting starts before the previous one ends.
approaches.why: The sort dominates; one pass after it.

quiz.q: Why is comparing only neighbours enough after sorting?
options: Earlier meetings started even sooner; if i doesn't clash with i − 1, it can't clash with them unless i − 1 does
Because there are at most two meetings
